system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> why tf does your app play ‘suggested music’ instead of the actual music I want, even when I’ve turned off auto play?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! It sounds like you're experiencing Suggested Tracks, which can happen even with autoplay off. Can you DM us your account's email or username so we can help you out? 🎶 /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply tone is informal and includes 'DM' which may confuse users on this platform."}
